decisions.reason: Selecting question-appropriate answer layers after curation does not change the question-review count, removal criteria, actions, or streamlining goal.
The revised answer-layer structure applies to question answers and does not change the checklist deliverable, audience focus, content guidance, or chapter-length guidance.
The answer-layer decision does not alter the requirement to cover questions leadership candidates can ask interviewers.
Changing the available and question-specific answer layers does not change the requirement to show international and industry differences in questions and answers.
The answer-layer modification does not change the AI chapter's mandatory status or its required coverage of prompts, techniques, and tools.
The answer-layer modification does not affect the Google Doc editing artifact, change-tracking method, or optional PDF reference use.
The manuscript answer-layer structure does not change the companion-material deliverable, learning purpose, proposed resource types, or recommendation allowance.
The answer-layer modification does not change the chapter's subject of interview questions for first-time leaders.
The answer-layer modification does not change the requirement for remote and hybrid leadership interview questions.
Choosing different answer layers by question may affect drafting allocation but does not change the fixed 110,000-word ceiling or the recorded approximate existing word count.
